summary: xAI added a /goal mode to Grok Build that lets the coding agent plan, checklist, and execute long-running tasks autonomously with status, pause, resume and clear controls.

mechanisms.reason: The feature shifts the coding agent from back-and-forth turns to autonomous multi-step execution of delegated tasks.
mechanisms.quote: This new mode yields long-running, autonomous execution, helping you hand off larger implementation tasks to the agent.

practices.reason: The plan-checklist-execute loop with pause/resume/status controls is a concrete agent scaffolding pattern worth evaluating, though it is specific to Grok Build's own implementation.
practices.quote: It plans an approach, breaks the work into a progress checklist, and starts executing.

practices.reason: New slash-commands add a small interface surface to monitor and steer if teams adopt Grok Build.
practices.quote: /goal status # see the live progress panel /goal pause # stop work, keep the goal /goal resume # pick back up /goal clear # drop the goal entirely
